literal_meaning: অন্ন মারা (food dies or striking the food source)
figurative_meaning_en: To close off one's path to livelihood
similar_in_english: Kill the goose that lays the golden eggs
Cut off one's nose to spite one's face
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার নিজের ব্যবসা বন্ধ করে অন্ন মারা করলো।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত নিলে তুমি নিজের অন্ন মারবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He shut down his own business and killed his own livelihood.
If you make this decision, you'll be cutting off your own means of survival.
note: Rooted in agrarian context where 'ann' symbolizes staple sustenance like rice.
